T-this is...water, isn't it??\nI can absorb it with my roots, but...
Oh no, this is not good. We can't go under\nthe water.
Let's find a way to go under the water!
Aye, adventurer~!
I'm glad you guys are okay!\nHow was the negotiation with the Ranas? Did it\ngo well?
Once again, I'm sorry for the trouble I caused\nwhen you came here.
After being freed from the Coenubia, I spent some\ntime in Erva Tronc and was finally able to\nrecover...
My gosh, I got panicked back then, you know!\nIt was a real struggle to get rid of just the\nCoenubia without hurting you~.
Oh, c'mon Pelulu! You're being overdramatic.\nI was actually the one who saved Reliza with\nwater!
Hm? W-was it you?\nI kinda forgot, h-haha, hahaha...
I've started making medicine with the materials\nI can get. I hope someday I could repay you for\nsaving me.
I'm not saying that I can make everything, but if\nyou ever need something and I know how to make it,\nI'll gladly make it for you for free...
Apart from ark maintenance and repair, I've also\ndecided to do smelting works.
But ark maintenance still comes first. Smelting\nwill be a side hustle, so I won't be asking for\npayment either.
Hmm, having different shops on the ark is a good\nthing, but not getting paid for your services\ndoesn't sit right with me...
Eh?
Why? What's so bad about doing it for free?
I was intrigued by this adventurer at first, so\nI decided to tag along. But later, I find myself\noften inundated with various tasks for just being
around this adventurer. I even ended up agreeing\nto various absurd tasks from the king of the Elf\ncountry.
I think I should have got a country as a reward...\nBut you see, this is all I got! It's totally not\nworth the trouble!!
We have no choice.
I didn't get any reward though?
We do have a choice!! Even if you're fine with\nit, I don't like doing things that are not\nprofitable, you know!!
Oh? Your reward? I took it.
Oh? Your reward? I took it.\nBut then even with yours combined, it's still too\nlittle...
Oh? Your reward? I took it.\nBut then even with yours combined, it's still too\nlittle...What?
H-ha, hahaha! D-d-don't worry!\nI'm keeping it safe for you.\nT-there's no way I'd run off with it!
But when this adventure is over, I'll definitely\nask for what I deserve.
So you guys shouldn't offer to do things for free\nso easily either when you can actually make money.\nUnderstand?!
Uh, um...
Well, it doesn't really matter to me. It looks\nlike the royal dragon cocoon isn't in Movere\nSilva. We wanna go to the mainland to look for it.
You got on this ark for the same reason, didn't\nyou, Muti?
Y-yes, I want to go to the mainland of Toram to\nsave my fellow Eumanos who should be there...
To save them, I would like Pelulu and the\nadventurer to help me!
Sorry...
We've heard the story too.
We also wanna work with the Ranas on the mainland\nto fight against Coenubias. So we wanna go to the\nmainland...
Besides, I hope I could find out what exactly\nCoenubia is as it has been bothering me for a long\ntime...
Defeating Coenubia is our purpose too.\nThanks for reminding us once again.
We also need to find out what's happening to the\nthird race living in Toram, the Lixis.
Aye?
Alright, are you guys ready?\nWe're setting off for the mainland of Toram!
By the way, sorry for asking, but is it okay to\nload a lot of water onto the ark? Because I think\nwe need it for our survival.
Er, that might be difficult. First, we're having\nmore passengers now. Besides, I'm not sure where\nwe can put the water...
That's no good then!
Oh no, we're already facing a problem before we\neven leave!
Ugh, I know, but the ark wasn't built with the\nintention of carrying aquatic creatures. There's\nnothing we can do about it!
Hm, I guess we have no choice...We'll head to the\nmainland first through the waterway under Aqua\nGota that is connected to the mainland.
Is...is it safe though?!
The waterway isn't very wide, but it's safe and\nwide enough for me and Miss Mare to pass through.
But if the Coenubias that are resistant to water\ncome after you...
Don't worry, we'll have the warriors guard us to\nthe entrance of the waterway. We'll be fine.
Alright, let's meet by the waterside on the\nmainland!
You guys be careful too!
Okay, I guess we'll have to go and meet them\nthere!
Alright, off we go!
Alright, off we go! Hold on tight!!
